title: USF-172 Analytics Event-Store Provider Disposition Matrix

humanDecision.summary: Analytics/event-store decision is not completion evidence. USF-172 records a bounded disposition gate: deterministic in-memory analytics proof is allowed only where semantically permitted and is not equivalent to ClickHouse provider semantics. USF-197 records the service-semantic proof boundary, while actual ClickHouse adapter proof remains tracked by USF-206.

analyticsEventStoreDisposition.riskStatement: ClickHouse analytics/event-store provider semantics, persisted event ingestion, tenant-safe query, retention, replay, aggregation, provider failure modes, and cross-process visibility could be overclaimed from catalogue-only or in-memory evidence.
analyticsEventStoreDisposition.treatment: defer ClickHouse service-semantic adapter proof through USF-197 to USF-206 and keep in-memory analytics proof non-equivalent
deferredEvidence: ClickHouse SDK/client selection and adapter boundary evidence
retention, replay, and deletion boundary evidence
audit event evidence for analytics operations
readiness retry, timeout, teardown, and failure-mode evidence
supplier, secret, privacy, backup, incident, and vulnerability posture evidence

inMemorySubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: Deterministic in-memory analytics or event evidence may prove local semantic paths only when the relevant catalogue and proof row permit it. It is not equivalent to ClickHouse persisted event ingestion, queryable event history, aggregation, retention/replay, provider failure modes, SDK/client boundary, or cross-process/runtime visibility.
scopeCovered: repository records ClickHouse as an explicit deferred provider class
runtime provider manifest keeps ClickHouse unsupported-deferred
provider registry uses evidence-only support without endpoint or SDK
validator rejects in-memory equivalence and readiness overclaim
enterprise evidence rows record tenant, retention, audit, privacy, supplier, and incident boundaries
limits: no tenant-safe ClickHouse query or aggregation proof
no retention, replay, purge, or restore proof
no API or worker runtime use of ClickHouse
no analytics readiness or event-store readiness claim

providerBoundary.providerRegistryEvidence: packages/core/src/index.ts records analytics-store-clickhouse-deferred as deferred evidence-only support linked to the ClickHouse service catalogue row.
